clips.title: The story
paras: Dreadmist Den is a subterranean cavern carved beneath the crags of Dreadmist Peak in the northern Barrens. Controlled by the Burning Blade cult, the cavern is perpetually smothered in an unnerving red haze and serves as a shrine to demon worship.

Dreadmist Den lies tucked within the jagged slopes of Dreadmist Peak, serving as a dark sanctuary for the Burning Blade cultists. Inside, the air hangs heavy with a thick, crimson vapor that blankets the cavern in an eerie twilight. Far from the watchful eyes of the Horde in the plains below, the cult conducts foul demonic rites within these stone tunnels, guarding their blasphemous relics and plotting to spread their corruption across Kalimdor.
